select * from (select cc.contract_id, cc.contract_number, max(hlm.mortgage_id) mortgage_id, nvl(hlm.mortgage_number,'未抵押') mortgage_number, cc.document_type, cc.division, cc.manufacturer_id, (Select hbv.bp_code From hls_bp_master hbv Where hbv.bp_id = cc.manufacturer_id) manufacturer_code, (Select hbv.bp_name From hls_bp_master hbv Where hbv.bp_id = cc.manufacturer_id) manufacturer_id_n, cc.factory_id, (Select hbv.bp_name From hls_bp_master hbv Where hbv.bp_id = cc.factory_id) factory_id_n, (Select hbv.bp_name From hls_bp_master hbv Where hbv.bp_id = cc.tenant_id) tenant_name, replace(wm_concat(ccli.full_name), ',', ';') full_name, cc.employee_id host_project_manager, (select fe.name from fnd_employee fe where fe.employee_id = cc.employee_id) host_project_manager_n, (case when hlm.mortgage_number is not null or cc.contract_status != 'APPROVING' then null else case when to_date(to_char(sysdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') - to_date(to_char(cc.lease_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') between 0 and 90 then 90 - (to_date(to_char(sysdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') - to_date(to_char(cc.lease_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) || '天' when to_date(to_char(sysdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') - to_date(to_char(cc.lease_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') > 90 then '已逾期' end end) as overtimeCountdown from con_contract cc left join con_contract_lease_item ccli on cc.contract_id = ccli.contract_id left join hls_lease_mortgage hlm on hlm.contract_lease_item_id = ccli.contract_lease_item_id where cc.document_type in ('CONL', 'CONLB') --and cc.contract_status in ('REJECTED', 'APPROVED_RETURN', 'CONDITIONAL', 'APPROVING', 'APPROVED') group by cc.contract_id, cc.contract_number, cc.contract_status, hlm.mortgage_number, cc.document_type, cc.division, cc.manufacturer_id, cc.factory_id, cc.tenant_id, cc.employee_id, cc.lease_start_date) v
and v.CONTRACT_NUMBER like concat(concat('%',#{contractNumber}),'%')
and v.mortgage_number like concat(concat('%',#{mortgageNumber}),'%')
and v.manufacturer_id_n = #{manufacturerIdN}
and v.factory_id_n = #{factoryIdN}
and v.tenant_name like concat(concat('%',#{tenantName}),'%')
and v.host_project_manager_n like concat(concat('%',#{hostProjectManagerN}),'%')
order by v.contract_id desc

select * from (select cc.contract_id, cc.contract_number, cc.contract_name, cc.document_type, cc.division, hlm.mortgage_id, hlm.mortgage_number, cc.manufacturer_id, (Select hbv.bp_code From hls_bp_master hbv Where hbv.bp_id = cc.manufacturer_id) manufacturer_code, (Select hbv.bp_name From hls_bp_master hbv Where hbv.bp_id = cc.manufacturer_id) manufacturer_id_n, cc.factory_id, (Select hbv.bp_name From hls_bp_master hbv Where hbv.bp_id = cc.factory_id) factory_id_n, (Select hbv.bp_name From hls_bp_master hbv Where hbv.bp_id = cc.tenant_id) tenant_name, ccli.contract_lease_item_id, ccli.full_name, cc.employee_id host_project_manager, (select fe.name from fnd_employee fe where fe.employee_id = cc.employee_id) host_project_manager_n, hlm.actual_province_code, (select f.description from fnd_province f where f.province = hlm.actual_province_code) actual_province_code_n, hlm.actual_city_code, (select f.description from fnd_city f where f.city = hlm.actual_city_code) actual_city_code_n, hlm.vehicle_regist_number, hlm.vehicle_owner, hlm.mortgage_regist_number, hlm.mortgagee_name, hlm.mortgage_regist_date, ccli.classify_id, (select ic.attribute_value from yx_lease_item_classify ic where ic.classify_id = ccli.classify_id) classify_id_n, hlm.location, hlm.registration_authority, hlm.description, ccli.product_model from con_contract cc left join con_contract_lease_item ccli on cc.contract_id = ccli.contract_id left join hls_lease_mortgage hlm on hlm.contract_lease_item_id = ccli.contract_lease_item_id where cc.document_type in ('CONL', 'CONLB') --and cc.contract_status in ('REJECTED', 'APPROVED_RETURN', 'CONDITIONAL', 'APPROVING', 'APPROVED') ) v where v.contract_id = #{contractId}

SELECT pp.process_instance_id, pp.project_id, cc.CONTRACT_NUMBER, cc.mortgage_status, ( SELECT sc.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v sc WHERE sc.code = 'CON_CONTRACT.MORTGAGE_STATUS' AND sc.CODE_VALUE = cc.mortgage_status ) mortgage_status_n, ( SELECT hbv.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbv WHERE hbv.bp_id = pp.manufacturer_id ) manufacturer_id_n, ( SELECT hbv.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbv WHERE hbv.bp_id = pp.tenant_id ) bp_id_tenant_n, ( SELECT bt.description FROM hls_business_type bt WHERE bt.DOCUMENT_CATEGORY='PRJ_PROJECT' AND bt.business_type = pp.business_type ) business_type_n, cc.division, ( SELECT d.description FROM hls_division d WHERE d.division = pp.division ) division_n, ( SELECT fe.NAME FROM FND_EMPLOYEE fe WHERE fe.EMPLOYEE_ID = pp.EMPLOYEE_ID ) employee_id_n, ( SELECT u.unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit u WHERE u.unit_id = pp.unit_id ) unit_id_n, ( SELECT h.actual_pay_date FROM csh_payment_req_hd h, csh_payment_req_ln l, con_contract_cashflow cf WHERE h.payment_req_id = l.payment_req_id AND l.source_doc_category = 'PRJ_PROJECT' AND l.source_doc_id = cf.contract_id AND l.source_doc_line_id = cf.cashflow_id AND cf.contract_id = cc.contract_id ) actual_pay_date , mortgage_approved_date FROM CON_CONTRACT cc INNER JOIN PRJ_PROJECT pp ON cc.PROJECT_ID = pp.PROJECT_ID
1=1
and cc.contract_number like concat(concat('%',#{contractNumber}),'%')
and cc.mortgage_status = #{mortgageStatus}
and ( SELECT hbv.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbv WHERE hbv.bp_id = pp.manufacturer_id ) like concat(concat('%',#{manufacturerIdN}),'%')
and (SELECT hbv.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbv WHERE hbv.bp_id = pp.tenant_id ) like concat(concat('%',#{bpIdTenantN}),'%')
